XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Occasionally, the gearbox locks in a selected gear, causing a loss of traction.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GROUP | GEARBOX | ROBOTISED | TIMES | BLOCK | MISSING | LOSES | MOVES | VEHICLE | ENGINE | CAR |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles equipped with robotic gearboxes

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Robotic gearbox unit

  • Fault: The gearbox occasionally locks in a selected gear, causing a loss of traction.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty robotised gearbox unit

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the robotic gearbox unit; replace if necessary.

  • Procedure:

  • Note: In this case, the defective component did not show any visual abnormalities.
